api.execution: Additive bounded library checks in workflow_assurance.py, no CLI or scheduler. First two APIs read only; rollback is the sole explicitly mutating API and invokes only Git worktree manager removal of one fully validated owned detached attempt. No shell interpolation, repository reset/clean, manual recursive delete, network/model/process execution or state writes. All invalid input fails before any removal.
api.reuse: Reuse finite exact JSON validation, AssuranceError, canonical/SHA, relative_path/pointers, regular_file, immutable _entry_blob/_receipt_artifact, existing contract/run_state/feature_list schemas via jsonschema and relevant existing ownership guards. Do not copy or modify existing engines/schema/helpers. Existing validate.sh/verify_lib.sh remain compliance authority. Existing120 aligned-repository constraint remains; no implicit alias normalization/migration or current Root live-adoption claim.
api.trust_boundary: Trusted Orchestrator selects immutable policy/artifact refs and serializes admission against its current coordination snapshot. Hashes, recorded owner IDs and schema validity prove binding/integrity, not authentication or human consent. No separate scheduler/lock service/authority store; assessments are proposals, not an atomic reservation. Untrusted requests cannot choose a new authority, free active ownership, override dependencies/counters or patch state. Stale simultaneous caller snapshots are not claimed race-free; the single Orchestrator must apply the decision before issuing another admission.
api.policy_shape: Exact object repository,coordination_ref,feature_list_ref,authority_ref,attempt_parent,rollback_ref. Refs exact path/sha256/revision using existing120 immutable reference profile; rollback_ref null or such ref. repository literal Git origin string, attempt_parent existing canonical absolute nonsymlink directory outside repo and its Git common directory. Coordination and feature list must have safe live regular bytes/mode matching their pinned historical refs, making stale coordination fail closed while permitting unrelated evidence-only HEAD advances. Authority is immutable historical approved dispatch, not required byte-equal to later mutable metadata.
api.request_shape: Exact object operation_id,feature_id,owner,agent_role,step_key,attempt,base_revision,attempt_root,writes,state_fields. IDs/owner/role/key nonempty strings; owner exact nonempty agent_id/session_id object. attempt exactinteger1..3; base_revision exact lowercase40hex real commit. attempt_root canonical absolute nonsymlink directory, strict child of policy.attempt_parent. writes nonempty unique canonical relative file paths, no Git administration paths. state_fields unique canonical non-root JSON pointers validated by existing pointers, may be empty. No request status, terminal, approved, authority override or arbitrary patch fields.
api.authority_shape: Pinned authority exact schema_version(integer1),role(Orchestrator),repository,approved(exactTrue),contract_ref and every request field. Every request value must exactly equal this independently selected dispatch. contract_ref reads immutable approved existing contract: schema valid, IDs equal requested feature, status approved, approvals.validator_mode_a/evaluator_contract_review exactTrue; its actual dual independent gate artifact references are selected by Orchestrator before dispatch, not inferred from request. Public code uses no particular phase/session/budget/owner identity constants. This dispatch records existing scoped authority, not a new human approval or authentication mechanism.
api.coordination_shape: Read existing run_state schema-valid object with repository==policy.repository, current_feature==request.feature_id, active_contract_id==feature_id if present, status exactly in_progress. Required optional execution_lanes list lives within this same object; no mandatory change to consumers that do not invoke121 APIs. Each lane exact request fields plus status and terminal_ref. status only reserved/running/invalidated/released; first three retain conflicts. terminal_ref null for nonreleased lanes; released requires independently pinned release record described below. Unique operation IDs, exact finite types and original counter/history preservation mandatory. Current feature list is existing schema-valid shape with phase==state.current_phase, exactly one selected in_progress feature, exact declared dependencies satisfied by unique complete/passes exactTrue or cancelled predecessors. A request cannot supply its own dependency verdict. No cancelled canonical-phase status is invented.
api.terminal_proof: Released lane requires immutable record exact schema_version(integer1),role(Orchestrator),operation_id,feature_id,owner,attempt,base_revision,attempt_root,released(exactTrue),actual_exit(exactinteger0); all bindings equal lane. actual_exit describes successful release/cleanup verification only and never changes an underlying failed operation into a pass. Missing/wrong/nonbool/foreign release proof or request terminal labels reject, rather than freeing ownership. These are trusted Orchestrator capture assertions with integrity checks, not authentication of process termination. Terminal failure evidence remains separate and unchanged.
api.lane_conflicts: Validate authority/current coordination/dependencies and attempt counter before assessing. Ignore only same operation's exact bound lane (if present); conflicting same-ID content rejects. All other nonreleased lanes conflict if any write path equals or is an ancestor/descendant of a requested path, or state pointer components equal/contain each other. A full shared file always serializes even disjoint field claims. Different paths and disjoint state pointers with satisfied dependencies may proceed. Return exactly eligible(exactbool),conflicts(ordered conflicting operation IDs),operation_id; deterministic existing lane order, independent copies/no mutation. Conflict is normal eligibleFalse, malformed/spoofed authority is AssuranceError. Root alone records reservation/admission using existing coordination.
api.attempt_counter: Require state.circuit_breaker[request.step_key] object with exactinteger attempts matching request.attempt, exactinteger limit3; zero/not-yet-allocated, bool/string/reset/mismatched values or attempt4 reject. Root alone allocates/advances counters and preserves prior steps; no changes for source/process/agent/generation/stage or failure cause. This uses existing universal max3, no new cause policy or independent retry budget.
api.isolation: verify calls lane assessment and rejects eligibleFalse. Observe actual git worktree list --porcelain records, actual Git toplevel/common directory and exact resolved attempt root. Require one registered detached worktree in same repository/common directory; never main/shared worktree, repo/root/ancestor or Git administration path. Actual HEAD must be real descendant of authority base_revision; changes from base (including committed/staged/worktree/untracked/ignored paths) must lie in declared writes. Reject unmerged entries, symlinked path components/submodule/unsafe modes, renamed paths outside ownership and any unowned changed/additional path. Base tracked files may exist unchanged. Return exactly operation_id,attempt,base_revision,attempt_root,head_revision,owned_changes(sorted actual relative changed paths); no directory creation or counter/state mutation. No fake filesystem-only directory or merely changed HOME qualifies as isolation.
api.rollback: rollback first performs full verify_isolated_attempt and revalidates current snapshot, worktree registration/base/root and owned-change inventory immediately before removal. policy.rollback_ref must pin actual captured failure/quarantine record outside attempt: exact schema_version(integer1),role(Orchestrator),operation_id,feature_id,owner,attempt,base_revision,attempt_root,captured(exactTrue),actual_exit(exactinteger nonzero). Bind all fields to request; this nonzero remains failure and may be semantic/setup/infrastructure without reclassification. Read actual referenced proof bytes at the coordinator root before removal; never remove evidence inside the only failing root. Invoke git worktree remove --force with exactly that validated absolute root, no glob/fallback cleanup. After success require root absent and registration absent; return exactly operation_id,attempt_root,removed(exactTrue). Git/removal errors raise and remain failures; no claim of transactional rollback across concurrent hostile filesystem changes. Orchestrator must ensure exclusive ownership and no active process before calling; this API does not terminate processes.
api.preservation: Rollback may discard only declared changed files within the owned attempt and its unchanged private base copy; any unowned sentinel/new change inside root blocks removal. Other task roots, coordinator files, prior committed proof and sibling/outside sentinel must retain actual bytes/modes. Negative controls must demonstrate refusal before side effects for wrong owner, shared/nested/symlink/root/revision/registration/undeclared changes/missing evidence. No live shared developer tree rollback is authorized; acceptance uses newly created owned scratch worktrees only.
api.errors: All inputs finite acyclic exact JSON; no truthiness/coercion/default ownership. Invalid/missing/stale/unsafe/schema/Git/OS/recursion data raises existing AssuranceError with nonempty bounded diagnostic, no successful result or input mutation. Actual failed Git exit/output is evidence, never intended behavioral-red. Released-record/proposal shapes explicit above; no universal AGF arrays invented for dispatch/release/failure records. Return objects never alias inputs. Schema validation follows actual existing field names/types, not guessed enums or stale definition counts.
